values.note: Shaded gravel sites, one vehicle per site; the owner or a designee helps every RV into its space. RVs are subject to manager approval.

note: Family-owned RV park (since 2008) just off US-1 in Moncure, half a mile from Jordan Lake and its boat ramp; shaded gravel sites, big-rig friendly, small fish-farm pond. No tents (county ordinance), no open campfires. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site: 30/50-amp full hookups, free WiFi, park store, reservations by phone. Cleared the note-derived site count (45) and year-round season, which no operator page states. No rate is posted ('call for rates'). Note trimmed of the count and season.
flags: Long-stay test 2 fails: the operator posts no nightly (or any) rate - 'Please call (919)770-6890 for rates and reservation' - and has no booking engine. The guidelines read like a long-stay park too ('RVs and campers are subject to manager approval', 'Please store all items except patio furniture neatly under RV', 'No clothes lines', 'No vehicle maintenance').
No 2024+ rate found; price gate unchecked (nearest gateway Raleigh 43 km, outside 40 km; the family has not stayed here).
Presence: operator website (Copyright 2026) with phone (919) 770-6890 (matches), Google Maps 4.5 stars from 56 reviews.
